display.purpose: In-app section/page headings. Landing-page hero headings use larger one-off sizes outside this scale.

title.purpose: Card and modal titles, sub-section headers.

body.purpose: Default reading text and form copy.

meta.purpose: Secondary/supporting text — timestamps, counts, helper text.

micro.purpose: Smallest tier — pill labels, badges, compact tab captions.

shadows.name: modal-lift
shadows.purpose: The only elevation role: modals and dialogs lifting above the page.

shadows.name: toast-lift
shadows.purpose: Lighter lift for the transient toast notification.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Default transition for buttons and interactive controls.

motion.name: toast-ease
motion.purpose: Toast enter/exit motion — the system's one expressive easing curve.

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: Pulsing ring on live/active status dots.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action — teal fill, dark text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; background:#2dd4bf; color:#0f1923; border:none; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 20px; font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:0.88rem; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.18s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2dd4bf; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:0.4; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color:#e8edf4; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius:10px; padding:10px 20px; font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:0.88rem; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.18s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2dd4bf; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Tinted pill for status/role — the system's one decorative device (shown here in the verified-green variant).
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:100px; font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:700; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; background:#4ade8022; color:#4ade80; border:1px solid #4ade8044; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default content surface — one tone above the app background.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#1e2d40; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius:14px; padding:20px 22px; color:#e8edf4; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; line-height:1.6; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Sunken-feel field with teal focus glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius:10px; padding:10px 14px; color:#e8edf4; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-size:0.88rem; outline:none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#2dd4bf; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #2dd4bf22; }

components.name: Role Accent Tab
components.description: Active/inactive navigation tab; icon and label pick up the current role's accent color when active (teal shown here for parent).
components.css: .ds-tab { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:7px 12px; border-radius:8px; border:none; background:transparent; color:#8b9bb0; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; font-size:0.78rem; line-height:1.5; font-weight:400; cursor:pointer; transition:color .15s, background .15s; } .ds-tab--active { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color:#fff; font-weight:600; } .ds-tab--active .ds-tab-icon { color:#2dd4bf; }

narrative.overview:
BabyWatch is used in the evening, on a phone, often one-handed — a parent checking a booking, glancing at a live feed, or messaging a sitter before bed. The interface reads as a calm, dim control surface built for that moment: a dark-navy console you can trust in low light, not a bright consumer app you browse in daylight. Warmth comes from clarity — legible information, correct states, honest empty states — never from decoration. The subject matter (children, allergies, medication, emergency contacts) rules out anything cute or playful; the small scale of the product today (a handful of real users, not thousands) rules out any dashboard bravado.

Two explicit anti-references keep this system honest: it must not read as a "young parents" app (pastels, balloons, child illustrations, bubbly rounded type), and it must not read as an infrastructure/ops dashboard (dense, purely operational, cold). The intended register sits closer to Doctolib or Qonto's sobriety than to Airbnb's warmth — trustworthy through precision, not through friendliness.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy surfaces layered by tone, not by shadow
One functional accent per role — teal for parent, amber for sitter — used sparingly, never decoratively
Bold rounded-sans (Nunito) for structure and headings, neutral humanist-sans (Inter) for reading and data
Flat by default; heavy shadow reserved strictly for modals lifting above the page
Custom stroke-based SVG icon set for all functional/navigational icons — no emoji in that role
Bilingual (FR/AR) with full RTL support; layouts must hold up mirrored

rules.name: The Role Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal marks parent-context UI, amber marks sitter-context UI, everywhere — tabs, buttons, badges, role switchers. This mapping is binding; any exception is a bug, not a variant.

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Warmth and trust come from clarity, not from decoration. Do not introduce new saturated colors, brighter accents, or larger color fills to make a screen feel friendlier. If a screen feels cold, fix it with better copy and hierarchy, not more color.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Nunito is structural (headings, buttons, tab labels, brand); Inter is everything read at length. Don't use Nunito for paragraph text or Inter for a primary CTA label.

rules.name: The Evening Thumb Rule
rules.body: Primary actions on mobile screens belong within comfortable one-handed thumb reach; don't place a screen's primary CTA only at the very top of a tall scrolling view.

rules.name: The Modal-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If it's not a modal, dialog, toast, or the landing page's camera-frame visual, it doesn't get a shadow — use layering + border instead.

dos: Do keep teal strictly on parent-context UI and amber strictly on sitter-context UI (The Role Accent Rule).
Do use tonal layering (night → panel → card → sunk) plus hairline borders for depth; reserve shadow for modals, dialogs, and toasts only.
Do use the custom SVG stroke-icon set for anything functional/navigational.
Do verify any new layout against the RTL (Arabic) flip.
Do keep Fog Gray (#8b9bb0) exactly as specified for secondary text; it was tuned for contrast on these dark surfaces.
Do let empty states stay genuinely empty.
donts: Don't add pastel colors, illustrated children, balloons, or bubbly/rounded-beyond-current-scale shapes to "warm up" a screen.
Don't go cold/infrastructure-dashboard either — a parent is entrusting a child, not monitoring a server.
Don't use emoji as functional or navigational icons.
Don't add a shadow to an at-rest surface (cards, panels, nav).
Don't fabricate scale or social proof (counters, testimonials, ratings) in any component.
